subject: Sapphire Proofpoint: POC resourcing & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sapphire Proofpoint: POC resourcing & acceptance criteria

Hi Leni —

Thanks again for today’s discovery call. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth before we loop procurement: 

Scope (proposed)
- 4-week POC to validate performance and cost profile for your re-ranking + conversational flows against 500k monthly queries.
- Two workloads: real-time chat (latency-focused) and nightly batch reranks (throughput-focused).

Success criteria (please confirm)
- Latency: p50 < 75ms, p95 < 300ms for single-turn chat with context window <= 1024 tokens.
- Throughput: sustain 1200 rank requests/minute in batch mode (95th percentile).
- Quality: rerank MAP gain >= 8% vs baseline on your evaluation set.
- Cost: end-to-end cost per 1M tokens below target we discussed (TBD by you).

Capacity ask (initial suggestion)
- Reserve: 3x NVIDIA A100 40GB for dedicated POC pool (baseline).
- Autoscaling: allow burst to up to 8 instances for peak synthetic load during ramp tests.
- Networking: EU-region VPC (data residency) with private peering to Sapphire.

Operational notes
- We’ll enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts and a small model-quantization profile to reduce per-token cost.
- We recommend keeping a short TTL on cache during A/B tests to avoid stale signals.

Next steps (ask for confirmation)
1) Confirm acceptance criteria above or list any edits.
2) Share procurement contact and PO timeline (I’ll attach SOW draft).
3) I’ll put the capacity/price ask to our Dedicated team; Marissa and Karthik are copied to align on resource availability.

Attachments: sapphire_poc_scope.pdf, sizing_estimate.csv (est. GPU-hours and rough cost delta)

Thanks — happy to sync live if easier.

—
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales (Trials) | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

We can commit to 3x NVIDIA A100 (40GB) reserved for the first week of the POC. Operational details below: 

- Reserved pool: 3x A100 (40GB) in eu-west-1 (private VPC peer).
- Autoscaling: policy will allow burst to 8 instances for short windows; we’ll gate burst with a synthetic load test window and an ops-approval step.
- Estimated performance (baseline ML config): p50 chat latency ~60–80ms, p95 ~260–320ms depending on sequence length and checkpointing. Nightly batch throughput estimate: 1,500–1,800 rank requests/minute when scaled to 8 nodes.
- Quantization: we’ll run int8 on the candidate model which should cut inference cost ~30% with 2–3% expected quality delta (we will label that in the evaluation plan).

Attachments: capacity_plan_sapphire.xlsx (detailed hours + cost), I’ve updated the SOW draft with Deal ID SAPPH-4827. See deployment request: https://console.redwood.ai/deployments/ops/req-1729
